title: glycosmis pseudoracemosa
intro: Glycosmis pseudoracemosa, commonly known as  Black Pepper Tree or Black Peppercorn Tree, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asia for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and other ailments. The therapeutic actions of Glycosmis pseudoracemosa include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
